items.title: There's a 'disconnect' between the market, rate of AI build-out: Qualcomm CEO
items.summary: Qualcomm (QCOM) CEO Cristiano Amon spoke to Yahoo Finance about the company's position in the AI marketplace and how it is adjusting to semiconductor shortages.

items.title: Nvidia, AMD, and Micron stocks lead chip sector higher following worst sell-off since 2020
items.summary: Nvidia, AMD, Micron, and Sandisk rebounded on Friday after the chip sector suffered its worst daily drop since 2020.

items.title: Qualcomm CEO: Its Data Center Ramp Is “All Supply Bound,” Not Demand Bound
items.summary: Key TakeawaysQualcomm stock fell about 11% this week after its earnings guidance for the December quarter came in below expectations. CEO Cristiano Amon says supply is the only thing limiting the company’s $5 billion data center revenue target for fiscal 2027.

items.title: Qualcomm Rises 5% on Alphabet’s $548 Million Stake as CEO Sees a “Disconnect” on AI
items.summary: Key TakeawaysQualcomm shares rose 5% today on Alphabet’s nearly $548 million stake. The stake backs Qualcomm’s data center push, still targeting $5 billion of revenue in fiscal 2027.

items.title: Qualcomm Faces Worst Day Since 2020 as Chips Crater

items.title: What Does QUALCOMM (QCOM) Winning A Nationwide 5G Buildout Mean For Investors?
items.summary: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and SpaceX have agreed a multiyear partnership to power the new Starlink Mobile nationwide 5G network. The project uses Qualcomm 5G infrastructure technology at national scale, taking the chip designer beyond its traditional smartphone-focused business. Starlink Mobile aims to offer a satellite-backed 5G service across the U.S., creating a new competitor to existing wireless carriers. This Starlink Mobile 5G infrastructure deal with SpaceX is a big swing for Qualcomm...
